statement: Let F be a field and set A± F = {f ∈ AF : f(−1) = 0}. (i) Every valuative subset Σ ⊂ AF has a unique coarsest valuation vΣ with Σ ⊂ IvΣ . In particular, vΣ coarsens every valuation whose inertia contains Σ. For such a valuation w, this coarsening is obtained by quotienting wF by its largest convex subgroup contained in w( T f∈Σ ker f). 5 (ii) If S ⊂ A± F is an alternating linear subspace, its valuative elements form a valuative sub- space S0 of codimension at most one. Moreover S ⊂ DvS0 . (iii) If Σ ⊂ A± F is valuative and g ∈ A± F is alternating with every element of Σ, then g ∈ DvΣ .
